description: Unit tests for the parse tree functionality in the Chromium project's GN build system, including tests for accessor nodes, subscripted access, unused variables, target shortening, range extraction, and integer parsing.

classes.name: AccessorNode
classes.description: Represents a node for member access in the parse tree.

classes.name: IdentifierNode
classes.description: Represents an identifier in the parse tree.

classes.name: InputFile
classes.description: Represents an input file in the parsing context.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Represents a lexical token with location info.

classes.name: Err
classes.description: Represents an error with location info.

classes.name: Value
classes.description: Represents a value in the scripting environment.

classes.name: Scope
classes.description: Represents a scope for variable storage.

classes.name: ListNode
classes.description: Represents a list node in the parse tree.

classes.name: ParseNode
classes.description: Base class for parse tree nodes.

classes.name: TestParseInput
classes.description: Test fixture for parsing input and execution.
